science.title: Why creatine works
science.text: Your muscles use a molecule called ATP for short, explosive effort — and they run out of it fast. Creatine helps regenerate ATP, so you get more reps, more power and more out of every session. Decades of research make it the most-proven supplement for strength and lean muscle. We keep ours 100% pure: 5 g of creatine monohydrate, nothing else.

items.a: Creatine monohydrate is one of the most-studied supplements in the world, with decades of research supporting its safety and effectiveness in healthy adults.

items.q: Do I need to load it?
items.a: No — a single 5 g scoop daily saturates your muscles within 2–3 weeks. A loading phase just gets you there a few days sooner.
Any time of day works — what matters is taking it every day, including rest days, to keep your muscles topped up.

items.q: Will it make me bulky or bloated?
items.a: Creatine supports lean muscle, not bulk. Some early water retention in the muscle is normal and gives a fuller look — it's not fat.

items.q: Can I mix it with my protein?
items.a: Yes — it's unflavoured and mixes cleanly into water, juice, a protein shake or your pre-workout.
